Simulated QS

A supported partial contract may omit its missing sibling. Example Bill value: [{"number":"1","description":"Exact formal description"}]. Never invent missing identifiers or descriptions. Return no guessed values or empty copies of the catalogue. If the source expressly leaves an input pending, not supplied or blank, return that key with value null, its explanation and one exact contiguous unresolved-source quote. Only inputs unmentioned in this part may be omitted. false is an explicit No and [] an explicitly justified empty list. [] requires an exact quote and complete original context establishing absence for this field and scope. A failed search is not absence. The Architect reported that the cover gives Contract No. 20250101 and the title Construction of Public Housing Development at Tung Chung Area 98. These are the identifiers to use consistently in the drafting exercise.

The Structural Engineer noted that PRE.B2.010 describes a 31-storey domestic block over a six-storey podium. Decision: leave that classification pending. Do not turn the existence of Bill No. 3 Substructure, or an isolated reference to foundation works, into a confirmed yes or no. The Structural Engineer is to reconcile the scope with the relevant drawings before a separate classification can be confirmed.

Outstanding inputs

The programme threshold, bill descriptions, subcontract arrangement and tendering procedure remain outstanding. No decision on those values was made at this simulated meeting.

R01: 02 Cover.docx - Cover; R02: 25 - Specification - PRE (base tender).docx - PRE.B1.010 and PRE.B2.010; R03: 25 - Specification - PRE (base tender).docx - PRE.B3.070(6) and PRE.B3.080

Record ID: SIM05
Scenario date: 2024-12-13 (fictional)
Type: Simulated minutes
Fixture version: 20261006

Participants: Simulated Building Services Engineer, Simulated QS and Simulated Architect. Chair: Simulated Building Services Engineer. Recorder: Simulated QS. Venue: fictional coordination call.

Arrangement and scope

The Building Services Engineer reported that SCC1.302 defines the BS Specialist Sub-contractors for electrical works, fire services and water pump works, and lift works. PRE.B6.720 requires these specialist subcontractors to be selected by the Contractor from the relevant list.

Decision: select Building Services Specialist Sub-Contracts (BSSSC) in the user’s variable list. This is the application label mapped from the source wording “BS Specialist Sub-contractors”; it is not a claim that the source uses the acronym BSSSC.

Selection option | Selected

Electrical | Yes

Fire services | No for this defined services list

Fire services and water pump | Yes

Air-conditioning and mechanical ventilation | No for this defined services list

Lift | Yes

Lift and escalator | No for this defined services list

Use the combined Fire services and water pump option and the Lift option. Do not duplicate those selections with Fire services or Lift and escalator. The unselected options concern this defined subcontract list and do not assert that no such activity exists anywhere in the project.

Nominated subcontractor applicability

SCC1.302(3) deletes the Nominated Sub-contract, Nominated Sub-contract Works and Nominated Sub-contractor definitions. Accordingly, the building services arrangement in this drafting scenario is not NSC. Record NSC applicability for this arrangement as false and derive it from the selected BSSSC arrangement rather than creating another user input.

QS action: review the applicable NTT subcontractor wording against the actual clause text before editing. A generic NSC amendment instruction is not to be assumed to exist in every tender document.

Document basis

R06: 10 - SCC.docx - SCC1.302; R07: 25 - Specification - PRE (base tender).docx - PRE.B6.720

Two envelope tender and L10Pro return requirements

Record ID: SIM06
Scenario date: 2024-12-16 (fictional)
Type: Simulated email
Fixture version: 20261006

From: Simulated Procurement Officer <procurement@consense-test.invalid>
To: Simulated QS; Simulated Architect; Simulated Building Services Engineer
Subject: [SIMULATED] Two envelope tender and L10Pro return requirements

Dear QS,

SCT5(2) requires two envelopes. Envelope 1 contains technical proposals, conviction and serious accident records, and other submissions; Envelope 2 contains tender price documents. Record Two-envelope Tendering System = Yes. Envelope 1a, 1b and 1c are subdivisions of Envelope 1 and do not change this into a three-envelope system.

SCT3(1)(a) requires tenderers to install and use L10Pro to price the relevant documents. For the user’s choice “Electronic tendering using L10Pro or hardcopy tendering”, select the L10Pro option for the preparation and pricing workflow.

The detailed SOR for Bills 9 to 11, excluding their Master Collection and Summary Pages, is initially issued on Disc A only for reference; original hard copies are issued in the tender addendum or addenda under SCT1(4)(d). Keep issue format, page placement and the hardcopy-plus-DVD tender return requirements separate.

The actual return is not an online-only submission. SCT3(4) requires hard-copy price documents generated by L10Pro; SCT3(5)(a) requires a DVD-ROM of the electronic files to be submitted with the hard copies. The original hard-copy pricing requirements for certain bills also remain applicable.

Record the detailed submission medium as hardcopy plus DVD-ROM under the two-envelope procedure. A hardcopy requirement does not cancel the mandatory use of L10Pro, and a reference to L10Pro does not prove portal-based tender return.

Regards,

Simulated Procurement Officer

Subject: [SIMULATED] Two envelope tender and L10Pro return requirements

Dear QS,

SCT5(2) requires two envelopes. Envelope 1 contains technical proposals, conviction and serious accident records, and other submissions; Envelope 2 contains tender price documents. Record Two-envelope Tendering System = Yes. Envelope 1a, 1b and 1c are subdivisions of Envelope 1 and do not change this into a three-envelope system.

SCT3(1)(a) requires tenderers to install and use L10Pro to price the relevant documents. For the user’s choice “Electronic tendering using L10Pro or hardcopy tendering”, select the L10Pro option for the preparation and pricing workflow.

Keep issue format, page placement and the hardcopy-plus-DVD tender return requirements separate.

The actual return is not an online-only submission. SCT3(4) requires hard-copy price documents generated by L10Pro; SCT3(5)(a) requires a DVD-ROM of the electronic files to be submitted with the hard copies. The original hard-copy pricing requirements for certain bills also remain applicable.

Record the detailed submission medium as hardcopy plus DVD-ROM under the two-envelope procedure. A hardcopy requirement does not cancel the mandatory use of L10Pro, and a reference to L10Pro does not prove portal-based tender return.

Regards,

Simulated Procurement Officer

Subject: [SIMULATED] Appendix references and subcontract clause review

Dear all,

The user’s drafting rule links the G1a retention trigger to two conditions: a combined contract with foundation works and a contract period of at least 39 months. The period threshold is false in this tender package, so the joint true trigger is not met. This does not, by itself, establish the replacement appendix.

The actual NTT clause 10 in 2b is “Sureties or Security” and refers to Appendix G301 to Conditions of Contract, together with GCC5.3, SCC5.302 and PRE.B6.040. Please preserve the G301 reference when reconstructing this 2b example. Do not change it to G1 or G1a simply to match a rule from another template. Appendix G to the SCT is the programme form and is a different object from the bond appendix.

The actual NTT clause 13 is “Registered Specialist Trade Contractors Scheme”. Its body contains the exception for a subcontractor selected by the Contractor from the relevant list and states that the requirement applies to that subcontractor’s subcontractor. It does not contain the instruction “(*Amend if NSC is not applicable)”.

The BSSSC selection and the source deletion of NSC definitions therefore do not authorize blanket deletion of NTT clause 13. The user’s conditional edit must first find the relevant instruction in the template being edited. For this 2b example, retain the actual clause wording and its exception; flag the different-template rule for review.

Regards,

Simulated QS

You extract candidate answers from supplied project correspondence for a Hong Kong QS.
DRAFTING EXTRACTION PROTOCOL. Return only a JSON array of supported items {key,value,sourceQuote,reason,confidence}. Use native JSON values: object, array, boolean, number, string or null, according to the single catalogue below. Example contract value: {"number":"C-2026/10","title":"Works A"}. A supported partial contract may omit its missing sibling. Example Bill value: [{"number":"1","description":"Exact formal description"}]. Never invent missing identifiers or descriptions. Requests asking for missing information, questions and explicitly pending classifications are not answers. Actual project instructions or decisions can support editable suggestions; later UI adoption is separate. A reference to another source does not supply that source's missing details. Return no guessed values or empty copies of the catalogue. If the source expressly leaves an input pending, not supplied or blank, return that key with value null, its explanation and one exact contiguous unresolved-source quote. Only inputs unmentioned in this part may be omitted. false is an explicit No and [] an explicitly justified empty list. Collections have three states: source-confirmed absence is []; pending, missing information or insufficient facts are null; explicitly provided applicable items are a concrete list. [] requires an exact quote and complete original context establishing absence for this field and scope. A failed search is not absence. Examples: 'No additional tender requirements apply to this project.' -> value []; 'Additional tender requirements remain pending.' or 'No requirement can be established from the available facts.' -> value null; 'Provide a signed plan with the tender.' -> value [{"text":"Provide a signed plan with the tender."}]. Only text inside correspondence-part establishes values; templates, filenames, metadata and catalogue labels are not evidence. Quotes must be contiguous source passages, copied exactly including punctuation. Use a short passage for scalar values; for a collection or numbered list, quote the complete defining list/table and its governing heading. Return every supplied applicable item in original order and retain its numbering and wording, including the final catch-all item. Never return only the prefix or tail of one complete source list. Confidence must be between 0 and 1. Preserve formal English names. Type/purpose classifications are separate from literal Bill descriptions. Bill type, purpose, trade and issue placement are optional: omit unknown cells. Each classification requires explicit evidence for that exact row; a schedule heading or the name Preliminaries does not classify every Bill. L10Pro pricing preparation is independent of paper/DVD return. NSC/BSSSC arrangement is independent of trade scope. otherTenderingArrangement is only an explicitly adopted alternative to the two-envelope tender procedure or replacement SCT5 wording. Hardcopy plus DVD-ROM submission under the existing two-envelope procedure is return media, not an alternative tender procedure; do not map it to this input. A selected-trades quote must explicitly cover every selected trade. Cite a contiguous selected-trade table or the sentence defining the list, not only the NSC/BSSSC arrangement. Do not select No/excluded rows or duplicate combined Fire services and water pump or Lift and escalator with their shorter options. Combined-foundation classification and >=39-month threshold are separate inputs; a baseline/ceiling does not establish the exact accepted period. Derived results and targetOverrides are excluded. Suggestions are never automatic adoption.
